baseline: Current root working-tree bytes including integrated continuity, ACP settlement and Claude resume. Only narrow attachment deltas are included; subsequent MCP wrapper edits remain untouched and all patches check clean.

sourceContracts.contract: Resolve actual mounted path. Known image plus advertised capability plus <=20 MiB => inline original bytes; otherwise file:// resource_link containing basename,size and optional image MIME. Stat/read failure => textual actual-path fallback.
Binary [0,255] remains a resource_link; >20 MiB PNG is not inline.
Workspace roots exclude att/apps/plugins/etc. resolveMountedPath performs lexical containment.
New/resume additionalDirectories are other workspace roots, not every attachment directory.
Client advertises plan/form/config capabilities, not a host attachment filesystem callback service.
Per-agent blobs: temp-rename write, archive preserves, hard-delete removes, fork copies.
Native universal-toolbox att mount is read-only. This does not establish external CLI filesystem enforcement.
Pinned Claude uses a Node>=22 ACP wrapper around installed Claude; ADE uses direct native stream-json.
Pinned Codex uses bundled ACP wrapper; ADE direct app-server is a different transport.

requirements: ade_harness adds Qt6::Sql; existing glob picks new harness sources
Store failure-hook test compiles Store/PreparedTurn/Workspace independently with its test macro; never mix class layouts
Three dedicated fixture source files preserve shared Codex/ACP/Claude fixtures unchanged
Four new test targets; existing harness_files and attachments tests are retained

implementation.storage: Fixed host owner, pinned local Windows profile/ancestors, exclusive owner lock; SQLite FULL manifest plus physical file identities and captured hashes; separate harness-attachments/<sha256(owner)> path, never a selected workspace.
implementation.leases: Only captured host-validated original bytes construct leases. Read handles deny ordinary writer/deletion opens while active; no claim of an OS security boundary against the same user.
implementation.preparation: Copied immutable owner/mount/history inputs run on QtConcurrent, with atomic cancellation and Engine generation/current-job checks before process dispatch. HTTP preparation remains separate.
implementation.canonicalHistory: Replay selects exact reference+hash identities only from the latest ade_compressedHistory boundary onward, current message once, previous rows chronologically. Removed/future/older summarized references do not regain authority. Different versions of one logical path remain distinct.
implementation.transport: ACP file:// resource_link for arbitrary files and unsupported/oversized inline images. Direct Codex/Claude get bounded JSON text descriptors with actual owner-scoped paths. Existing image/text preparation is retained through a shared pure image conversion helper.
implementation.continuity: Cross-owner CLI history with attachment paths starts a fresh session using child-owned copies; fresh-session shutdown preserves just-prepared leases only after generation/lifetime validation. No permission flags, additional directories, approval mode or workspace grants are widened.
implementation.durability: Captured input is independent from evictable original snapshots. Fork copies original bytes into a new fixed owner; restart validates physical identity and digest. Cleanup retains a fixed-owner/profile/root identity receipt across final manifest/root deletion boundaries.
implementation.fallbackCleanupFix: MainWindow pending cleanup and failed-fork rollback now include both owned fallback files and durable handoff storage. HarnessFileContext::removeAgent adopts only an existing pinned physical owner root; absent cleanup never creates one. Pending markers survive blocked cleanup and clear only after successful retry.

READ_ATTRIBUTES-only directory blocker did not establish a sharing conflict on this Windows build; not claimed as reproduced product failure. Final regression uses GENERIC_READ, plus real process exits after manifest and root deletion.

limits: No live model, paid API, authentication file or user workspace was used. Exact bytes reaching fake native children do not prove every real CLI will permit reading those paths; existing runtime permissions may ask or deny.
Historical file replay is an explicit native continuity enhancement. Pinned ACP replays historical text only; this implementation does not claim transport or reasoning identity with Stagewise.
Existing inline image resizing/encoding follows native model caps. Original arbitrary-file bytes remain exact; inline encoded image bytes need not equal the original file.

Actual process _Exit recovery is tested at reserved-file, deleted-file, deleted-manifest and deleted-root boundaries. This is not a universal power-loss guarantee. A crash before ownership metadata/receipt identity becomes durable can leave an unclaimed reserved object that fails closed instead of guessing deletion authority.
Unknown files, changed hashes/physical identities, unavailable captured legacy inputs and capacity limits fail explicitly. There is no automatic eviction of durable handoff originals.

The existing uncommitted-fork rollback reports a cleanup error if removal itself fails; this slice does not add a new SessionStore transaction/retry-marker protocol around a failed rollback after a concurrent revision change. Existing pendingCleanup markers are preserved and tested.
Windows local-volume implementation only. No Linux/macOS port or same-user process confinement claim.
